instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes.
Do NOT use completely transparent backgrounds for headers or overlays.
Implement language toggle for Marathi/English (default Marathi).
Storefront should feel premium e-commerce (like Pepperfry), Admin should be dense and functional.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not apply universal transitions (transition: all).
Do not center align the app container text.
Create depth with layered z-index hierarchy and glass-morphism.
Avoid generic AI slop aesthetics; inject brand personality into spacing and typography.
Never use AI assistant emojis for icons.
